name: an object of enormous significance
description: An ordinary thing, placed here by someone paying full attention, and it is the most important object you have ever seen.
looks: Placed. Not left — placed, and every decision about it was correct.
It has weight the way a word has meaning.
You move it a centimetre and put it back, ashamed.
says: I have been here longer than the room.
Someone stood exactly where you are standing, for a very good reason.
Nothing is required of you. That is the point.
